local_changes: Resolve Next aliases to relative paths and use type-only React imports.
Compile complete foundation with explicit Tailwind scanning, flatten layers, scope selectors to .bui-root; host loads local Inter and JetBrains Mono font packages.
Thinking and tool state comes from runtime props rather than demo timers. Thinking accepts nested tool rows and observes changing trace height. Header has an accessible name.
Tool diff chips are omitted in the application adapter; long labels/details expose full text via title attributes.
Context cards support duplicate titles by position-qualified keys.
Flowchart accepts real edges, remeasures changed nodes, handles empty input and missing edge endpoints.
Selection Actions accepts a native-selection anchor and a real action callback; only standalone demo mode simulates rewrites. External toolbars fit or scroll on narrow screens.

Insight Cards exposes original AllocationCard with content props, guards empty/shrinking pages, translates pager labels and dispatches action callbacks. Production only uses real distributions; demo time series are not shown.
Tool detail text preserves line breaks and scrolls within a bounded height so persisted output remains readable.
